QuestInfo.name: Adding the Blue Dragon Cannon to the Canon
QuestInfo.0: That Blue Dragon Cannon would be a powerful addition to your Warp Forge.
QuestInfo.1: Give the ancient schematics for the Cannon to #bConey#k in #bBack Alley#k.
QuestInfo.2: You set Coney on the task and returned to HQ.

0.msg: The Blue Dragon Cannon is done, and I've finally got a little time to spare.\r\n

1.msg: Time to make the Blue Dragon Cannon the most powerful centerpiece in my Warp Forge collection!\r\n

2.msg: As much as I hate to admit it, this is beyond my skill set. I'll have to contact that wimp, Coney, for this one.\r\n

4.msg: Coney, listen, I need you to meet me at the alley. I've got some information that will make us both very happy.\r\n

5.msg: C-cadena? It's been a while. A-and you need a favor? What is it?\r\n

6.msg: It'll be easier to explain in person. Besides, I kinda miss that ugly mug of yours. Heh.\r\n

7.msg: W-well, I s-suppose I could meet with you. I'll meet you at the #balley#k right now.\r\n

yes.0: Perfect. I can head to the alley now. I knew it would be worth it to make a copy of these plans.\r\n#r(You will automatically move to the relevant field.)#k\r\n

no.0: Isn't there something I need to do?\r\n

0.msg: #b(Coney's fascinated by the schematic. It's definitely a sign of good weapons to come.)#k\r\n
This is... wow! W-where did you find this? I-I've never seen anything like it.\r\n

1.msg: I want to add it to my Warp Forge... with a few upgrades. I'm sure you can manage it. What do you say?\r\n

2.msg: Well, I'm always h-happy to research new weapons, and this looks like a f-fascinating challenge!\r\n

3.msg: All right then, get to work! I've gotta go in case HQ contacts me.\r\n

4.msg: I-I'm on it!\r\n#r(You will automatically move to the relevant field.)#k
